description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. was founded in 1949 to help clients focus on their business by solving their payroll challenges, and in the 77 years since has led the Human Capital Management industry in innovation, being the first in HCM to deliver automation, move to the cloud, provide a mobile app and create an online marketplace, and today building artificial intelligence into the core of how it orchestrates, governs and executes HR and pay processes. It describes itself as a trusted, service-driven and AI-enabled partner for HCM and a global leader in HR and payroll solutions, serving over 1.1 million clients and paying over 42 million workers in over 140 countries.
